page.content:
Inpesca is a formless expansive bluish-black mass, haunting both the Ecuadorian and Peruvian coasts, mentioned in the Cthäat Aquadingen as inimical to the Deep Ones.

page.overview:
What is Inpesca?

Inpesca is a formless expansive bluish-black mass, haunting both the Ecuadorian and Peruvian coasts, mentioned in the Cthäat Aquadingen as inimical to the Deep Ones.
